Messages.Author: François
Messages.Body:
Hello,

Young Bloods, with 1 life left, is in combat with Frederick the weak
with 1 blood. Each strike hands, so the Young Bloods are burned but
what about Frederick ? Does he go to torpor then gains 2 blood (my
guess) or does the 2 blood gain allow him to remain ready ?

Belle Equitone has the Martinelli's Ring. If she plays Mummify
(inferior), she goes to torpor untapped but the Mummify card is not
placed on her and she is not forbidden the leave torpor action : is
this correct ?

Thank you !

François

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
François wrote:
> Young Bloods, with 1 life left, is in combat with Frederick the weak
> with 1 blood. Each strike hands, so the Young Bloods are burned but
> what about Frederick ? Does he go to torpor then gains 2 blood (my
> guess) or does the 2 blood gain allow him to remain ready ?

Your guess is correct.

> Belle Equitone has the Martinelli's Ring. If she plays Mummify
> (inferior), she goes to torpor untapped but the Mummify card is not
> placed on her and she is not forbidden the leave torpor action : is
> this correct ?

She can't play Mummify on herself, since that is a card that requires [ser].

Messages.Author: coincoi...@hotmail.com
Messages.Body:
> > Belle Equitone has the Martinelli's Ring. If she plays Mummify
> > (inferior), she goes to torpor untapped but the Mummify card is not
> > placed on her and she is not forbidden the leave torpor action : is
> > this correct ?
>
> She can't play Mummify on herself, since that is a card that requires [ser].

Belle is the target of her ow "Strike: combat ends" then ? Or is it
due to the additionnal effect of Mummify?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Belle is the target of Mummify. Mummify's effect is: "Strike: combat ends. This
vampire untaps and goes into torpor; put this card on the vampire."
